title: Wellness
content: Bennett's Student Services page describes a 20-bed integrated Wellness Centre with round-the-clock medical facilities, nurse attendants and ambulance service.

title: Wi-Fi
content: Bennett states that its University Management System includes campus-wide Wi-Fi accessible to resident students, faculty and staff.

title: Transport
content: Bennett states that transport is available for day scholars, resident students, faculty and staff, with weekend shuttle services to nearby shopping areas, malls and the closest metro station.

title: Shopping and dining
content: Bennett states that campus has a convenience store, dining hall and multiple food outlets including Domino's, Southern Stories, Maggi Point and Snap Eats.

title: Banking
content: Bennett states that an on-campus ATM is available for students, faculty and staff.

title: Campus activities
content: Bennett describes campus life as including cultural festivals, college fests and sporting competitions that support student development and engagement.

title: Facilities
content: Bennett's infrastructure page lists facilities including cafeteria spaces, hostel blocks, Sports Complex, ATM, media labs, Wellness Centre, tuck shop, research centre, lecture rooms, orientation hall and laboratories.

title: Residential amenities
content: Bennett's current hostel page describes dining, laundry, sports and fitness facilities, Wellness Centre, salons and campus hangout spots as residential-life amenities.

title: Student Services
content: Bennett states that campus-wide Wi-Fi is accessible to resident students, faculty and staff.

title: Student Services
content: The dining hall serves breakfast, lunch and dinner to students and staff; the campus also has multiple food outlets.

title: Student Services
content: Bennett's Student Services page states that security staff are equipped with portable wireless communication devices for swift coordination.

title: Infrastructure
content: Bennett's infrastructure page lists a two-storeyed main cafeteria, non-veg cafeteria, air-conditioned hostel blocks, Sports Complex, 24×7 ATM, media labs, Wellness Centre, tuck shop, research centre, lecture rooms, orientation hall and 110+ labs.

title: Residential Services
content: Bennett describes Maggi Point, food joints near A and B blocks, a sports-complex hangout, hostel common entertainment rooms and the cafeteria as campus hangout spaces.
